seo.title: Contact Valencia Dentistry | Dentist in Santa Clarita
seo.description: Call (661) 254-5200, book online or send a message. Valencia Dentistry, 27420 Tourney Rd Suite 240, Santa Clarita, CA 91355. Open Mon to Fri 8am to 5pm.

sections.heading: We'd love to hear from you.
sections.lead: Questions, appointments or insurance checks: reach our friendly team by phone, online booking or the form below. We answer within one business day, usually much sooner.

image.alt: Dr. Neda Moezzi with three members of her team

sections.heading: Find us on Tourney Road
sections.lead: Suite 240 is on the second floor. Free parking on site and an elevator in the lobby.

sections.heading: Tell us how we can help
sections.lead: Share a few details and we'll call or email you back. For emergencies, please phone the office directly.

items.a: Yes. New patients are welcome and receive a comprehensive exam and digital X-rays for $59. Book online or call to reserve a time.

items.q: Which insurance plans do you accept?
items.a: We accept most major PPO plans, including Delta Dental, MetLife, Cigna, Aetna, United Concordia, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Principal and Humana. Call us to verify your specific plan.
Yes. Flexible financing options are available, and you will always receive a written estimate before treatment begins.

items.q: What should I bring to my first appointment?
items.a: A photo ID, your insurance card if you have one, a list of current medications and any recent X-rays from a previous dentist.

items.q: Can I be seen the same day for a dental emergency?
items.a: Often, yes. Call (661) 254-5200 as early as possible and we will do our best to see you the same day.
